WITH issue_based_denorm_cte AS
(
	SELECT  CAST(i.im_integration_id AS VARCHAR) AS im_integration_id
	       ,i.issue_key
	       ,i.is_active
	       ,i.project
	       ,i.assignee
	       ,i.reporter
	       ,i.custom_fields
	       ,i.components
	       ,i.labels
	       ,i.resolution
	       ,s.status_category                    AS issue_status_category
	       ,i.issue_type
	       ,i.issue_resolved_at
	       ,i.issue_url                          AS workitem_link
	       ,EXTRACT(YEAR
	FROM i.issue_resolved_at) AS issue_resolved_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER
	FROM i.issue_resolved_at) AS issue_resolved_quarter, EXTRACT(MONTH
	FROM i.issue_resolved_at) AS issue_resolved_month, EXTRACT(WEEK
	FROM i.issue_resolved_at) AS issue_resolved_week, EXTRACT(DAY
	FROM i.issue_resolved_at) AS issue_resolved_day, i.fix_versions AS fix_version_ids, i.summary AS issue_title, i.issue_created_at, i.fix_versions, i.status AS issue_status, s.status AS intermediate_status, s.status_start_time, pr.pr_uuid, pr.pr_created_at, pr.pr_merged_at, pr.target_branch, pr.pr_author_id, pr.reviewer_id, pr.review_state, pr.reviewed_at, c.scm_integration_id, c.commit_sha, c.author AS commit_author, c.committer, c.merge_commit, c.committed_at, i.version_id, i.version_name, i.version_released, i.version_release_date, EXTRACT(YEAR
	FROM i.version_release_date) AS version_release_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER
	FROM i.version_release_date) AS version_release_quarter, EXTRACT(MONTH
	FROM i.version_release_date) AS version_release_month, EXTRACT(WEEK
	FROM i.version_release_date) AS version_release_week, EXTRACT(DAY
	FROM i.version_release_date) AS version_release_day, i.sprint_ids, i.sprint_names, i.priority, i.team_id, i.assignee_id, i.reporter_id, i.epic, i.parent_key, i.parent_issue_type, i.parent_labels, i.hops, i.bounces, i.issue_updated_at, i.issue_due_at, i.story_points, c.scm_repo_id, c.scm_project, c.author_id, c.committer_id, c.commit_branch, c.direct_merge, pr.repo_id AS pr_repo_id, ci.ci_job_run_id, ci.ci_job_run_start_time, ci.ci_job_run_end_time, ci.ci_job_run_status, ci.ci_job_name, ci.ci_project_name, ci.ci_instance_id, cd.cd_job_run_id, cd.cd_job_run_start_time, cd.cd_job_run_end_time, cd.cd_job_run_status, cd.cd_job_name, cd.cd_project_name, cd.cd_instance_id
	FROM default_catalog.ftv8cfj4tiynizqzfs35xw.mv_denorm_issues i
	LEFT JOIN default_catalog.ftv8cfj4tiynizqzfs35xw.mv_denorm_issue_statuses s
	ON i.issue_key = s.issue_key AND i.im_integration_id = s.im_integration_id
	LEFT JOIN default_catalog.ftv8cfj4tiynizqzfs35xw.mv_denorm_issue_commits_info c
	ON i.issue_key = c.issue_key
	LEFT JOIN default_catalog.ftv8cfj4tiynizqzfs35xw.mv_denorm_issue_pr_info pr
	ON i.issue_key = pr.issue_key
	LEFT JOIN default_catalog.ftv8cfj4tiynizqzfs35xw.mv_denorm_issue_ci_info_complete ci
	ON i.issue_key = ci.issue_key
	LEFT JOIN default_catalog.ftv8cfj4tiynizqzfs35xw.mv_denorm_issue_cd_info_complete cd
	ON i.issue_key = cd.issue_key
)
SELECT  /*+ SET_VAR(cbo_cte_reuse=true) */ month
       ,year
       ,PERCENTILE_CONT(s1,0.5)     AS s1_median
       ,PERCENTILE_CONT(s1,0.9)     AS s1_p90
       ,PERCENTILE_CONT(s1,0.95)    AS s1_p95
       ,AVG(s1)                     AS s1_mean
       ,COUNT(s1)                   AS s1_count
       ,PERCENTILE_CONT(s2,0.5)     AS s2_median
       ,PERCENTILE_CONT(s2,0.9)     AS s2_p90
       ,PERCENTILE_CONT(s2,0.95)    AS s2_p95
       ,AVG(s2)                     AS s2_mean
       ,COUNT(s2)                   AS s2_count
       ,PERCENTILE_CONT(s3,0.5)     AS s3_median
       ,PERCENTILE_CONT(s3,0.9)     AS s3_p90
       ,PERCENTILE_CONT(s3,0.95)    AS s3_p95
       ,AVG(s3)                     AS s3_mean
       ,COUNT(s3)                   AS s3_count
       ,PERCENTILE_CONT(s4,0.5)     AS s4_median
       ,PERCENTILE_CONT(s4,0.9)     AS s4_p90
       ,PERCENTILE_CONT(s4,0.95)    AS s4_p95
       ,AVG(s4)                     AS s4_mean
       ,COUNT(s4)                   AS s4_count
       ,PERCENTILE_CONT(s5,0.5)     AS s5_median
       ,PERCENTILE_CONT(s5,0.9)     AS s5_p90
       ,PERCENTILE_CONT(s5,0.95)    AS s5_p95
       ,AVG(s5)                     AS s5_mean
       ,COUNT(s5)                   AS s5_count
       ,PERCENTILE_CONT(total,0.5)  AS total_median
       ,PERCENTILE_CONT(total,0.9)  AS total_p90
       ,PERCENTILE_CONT(total,0.95) AS total_p95
       ,AVG(total)                  AS total_mean
       ,COUNT(total)                AS total_count
FROM
(
	SELECT  im_integration_id
	       ,issue_key
	       ,issue_title
	       ,created_at                                                                                   AS issue_created_at
	       ,month
	       ,year
	       ,(CASE WHEN total_diff > 0 AND e1_END is not null THEN greatest(COALESCE(s1,0),0) ELSE 0 END) AS s1
	       ,(CASE WHEN total_diff > 0 AND e2_END is not null THEN greatest(COALESCE(s2,0),0) ELSE 0 END) AS s2
	       ,(CASE WHEN total_diff > 0 AND e3_END is not null THEN greatest(COALESCE(s3,0),0) ELSE 0 END) AS s3
	       ,(CASE WHEN total_diff > 0 AND e4_END is not null THEN greatest(COALESCE(s4,0),0) ELSE 0 END) AS s4
	       ,(CASE WHEN total_diff > 0 AND e5_END is not null THEN greatest(COALESCE(s5,0),0) ELSE 0 END) AS s5
	       ,total_diff
	       ,( (CASE WHEN total_diff > 0 AND e1_END is not null THEN greatest(COALESCE(s1,0),0) ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN total_diff > 0 AND e2_END is not null THEN greatest(COALESCE(s2,0),0) ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN total_diff > 0 AND e3_END is not null THEN greatest(COALESCE(s3,0),0) ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN total_diff > 0 AND e4_END is not null THEN greatest(COALESCE(s4,0),0) ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN total_diff > 0 AND e5_END is not null THEN greatest(COALESCE(s5,0),0) ELSE 0 END) ) AS total
	       ,COALESCE(e0_START,created_at)                                                                AS lttc_start_time
	       ,COALESCE(e5_END,e4_END,e3_END,e2_END,e1_END,e0_START)                                        AS lttc_end_time
	FROM
	(
		SELECT  im_integration_id
		       ,issue_key
		       ,issue_title
		       ,created_at
		       ,month
		       ,year
		       ,(e1_END - COALESCE(e0_START,created_at))                             AS s1
		       ,(e2_END - COALESCE(e1_END,e0_START,created_at))                      AS s2
		       ,(e3_END - COALESCE(e2_END,e1_END,e0_START,created_at))               AS s3
		       ,(e4_END - COALESCE(e3_END,e2_END,e1_END,e0_START,created_at))        AS s4
		       ,(e5_END - COALESCE(e4_END,e3_END,e2_END,e1_END,e0_START,created_at)) AS s5
		       ,e0_START
		       ,e1_END
		       ,e2_END
		       ,e3_END
		       ,e4_END
		       ,e5_END
		       ,(COALESCE(e5_END,e4_END,e3_END,e2_END,e1_END,e0_START) - e0_START)   AS total_diff
		FROM
		(
			SELECT  im_integration_id
			       ,issue_key
			       ,issue_title
			       ,created_at
			       ,month
			       ,year
			       ,e0_START
			       ,e1_END
			       ,e2_END
			       ,e3_END
			       ,e4_END
			       ,e5_END
			FROM
			(
				SELECT  im_integration_id
				       ,issue_key
				       ,issue_title
				       ,created_at
				       ,month
				       ,year
				       ,array_MIN(e0_start_list) AS e0_START
				       ,array_MIN(e1_end_list)   AS e1_END
				       ,array_MIN(e2_end_list)   AS e2_END
				       ,array_MAX(e3_end_list)   AS e3_END
				       ,array_MIN(e4_end_list)   AS e4_END
				       ,array_MIN(e5_end_list)   AS e5_END
				FROM
				(
					SELECT  im_integration_id
					       ,issue_key
					       ,COALESCE(MAX(NULLIF(issue_title,'')),ANY_VALUE(issue_title))                                     AS issue_title
					       ,month
					       ,year
					       ,ANY_VALUE(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(issue_created_at))                                                      AS created_at
					       ,array_filter(array_agg(distinct COALESCE(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(e0_START),e0_START)),x -> x IS NOT NULL) AS e0_start_list
					       ,array_filter(array_agg(distinct COALESCE(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(e1_END),e1_END)),x -> x IS NOT NULL)     AS e1_end_list
					       ,array_filter(array_agg(distinct COALESCE(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(e2_END),e2_END)),x -> x IS NOT NULL)     AS e2_end_list
					       ,array_filter(array_agg(distinct COALESCE(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(e3_END),e3_END)),x -> x IS NOT NULL)     AS e3_end_list
					       ,array_filter(array_agg(distinct COALESCE(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(e4_END),e4_END)),x -> x IS NOT NULL)     AS e4_end_list
					       ,array_filter(array_agg(distinct COALESCE(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(e5_END),e5_END)),x -> x IS NOT NULL)     AS e5_end_list
